user.title: tHAsk
user.description: Set up tHAsk? A first list will be created.

options.section: At the top in a section “Overdue”
options.separate: Not in “Today” but in a view “Overdue” of their own

add_task.name: Add task
add_task.description: Adds a task, optionally due on a day or within a week, month, quarter or year.

due_granularity.name: Due within
due_granularity.description: Precision of the due date. Without a date the current period is used (e.g. this week).

get_tasks.name: Get tasks
get_tasks.description: Returns tasks, e.g. everything due by the end of this week.

entity_id.name: List
entity_id.description: Only tasks of this list (empty = all).

import_ms_todo.name: Import from MS To Do
import_ms_todo.description: Imports a file created with tools/ms_todo_export.py. Tasks imported before are skipped. Admins only.

file.name: File
file.description: Path relative to the config folder.

skip_flagged_emails.name: Skip flagged emails
skip_flagged_emails.description: Do not import the automatic flagged emails list.

convert_month_ends.name: Month end → whole month
convert_month_ends.description: Tasks due on the last day of a month become due within that month.

convert_sundays.name: Sunday → whole week
convert_sundays.description: Tasks due on a Sunday become due within that week.

import_tasks.name: Import tasks
import_tasks.description: Imports tasks from Todoist, Google Tasks, TickTick, a CSV or an iCalendar file. Tasks imported before are skipped. Administrators only.

file.name: File
file.description: Path relative to the configuration folder, e.g. todoist.zip, Tasks.json or tasks.csv.

format.name: Format
format.description: Format of the file; automatic detection is usually enough.

list.name: Into list
list.description: Import everything into this list (created if needed). Empty: lists as in the file, or one list named after the file.

clear_completed.name: Clear completed
clear_completed.description: Deletes completed tasks of one list or all lists, optionally only older ones.

older_than_days.name: Older than (days)
older_than_days.description: Only tasks completed more than this many days ago.

data_description.overdue_in_today: Applies to the web interface, the app, the widget and the “Today” list in Home Assistant.
data_description.week_mode: With the next 7 days, next week is already in it on a Sunday.
data_description.separate_week: “Today” only shows tasks due on a specific day (and overdue ones); periods such as “week 44” are in “This week”, which in turn leaves out what “Today” shows.
data_description.separate_month: “This month” only shows what is due after this week until the end of the month, without overdue tasks.
data_description.hidden_views: These views do not appear in the navigation of the web interface, the apps and the widget. “Today” always stays.
data_description.auto_clear_days: Completed tasks are deleted this many days after they were ticked off, checked at start and every night. 0 = never.
data_description.reminder_targets: Notify services (notify.…) that receive reminders, e.g. the companion app on your phone (with a “Done” button) or persistent_notification for the bell in Home Assistant. The Windows app shows reminders on its own while it is running.
